about: Event entity created by the equipment system when an item is equipped (seen alive in the equipment, shove-throw, spells and death situations, where goblins were spawned with a longsword and the host was outfitted). bg3.exe+0x34FB760 walks an array of 0x18-byte records, creates one new entity per record and adds this component through bg3.exe+0x34FF800, which copies record+0 / +8 / +0x10. Read by esv::DualWieldingSystem (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x5EE1D0 EvaluateOnItemEquipped gets the slot byte and checks eoc::equipment::IsHandSlot).

evidence.says: bg3.exe+0x34FF800 writes at component +0 the 8-byte value its third argument points to (record+0). Live: 22 different handles, none equal to the host 0x7C3 -> the equipped item (each spawned goblin gets a fresh longsword).

bg3.exe+0x34FF800 writes at component +8 the 8-byte value its fourth argument points to (record+8). Live: includes the host character handle 0x7C3 (the equipment situation equips on the host) -> the character equipping the item.

bg3.exe+0x34FF800 writes at component +0x10 the byte its fifth argument points to (record+0x10). Toolkit esv::DualWieldingSystem::Update passes the byte at +8 of its own event copy to eoc::equipment::IsHandSlot / EvaluateOnItemEquipped(slot). Live values 3 and 5 = MeleeMainHand / RangedMainHand. ItemSlot is uint8_t (Enumerations/Stats.inl).
never written by bg3.exe+0x34FF800; live bytes are leftovers (0xFF...).

open_questions: Item vs Character order is taken from live data (host handle at +8), not from a named reader.
